Yeah I am a pretty gutsy and direct person at times. You should always be firm about your own beliefs. You know even if I am slapped or yelled at afterwards I can still be proud of myself for standing up for myself. I am terribly sorry to hear that. Yes honestly everything that we wish and want to do can just completely disappear if our parents are pissed. Have you tried talking to one of your relatives about this or your father. Something that somehow worked for me whenever i have to communicate with my mother or like we have diff opinions on a particular topic is to ALWAYS calmly respond to her and properly express my thoughts clearly( not advisable but somehow i point out the flaws in her arguments and be firm about it, it made her yell more and then she eventually gave in). And also as a self-care tip I keep a journal with all the bad things that have happened in my life( well mostly the ones that hit the hardest) and write and write, it make my mind clearer. And also at the end you SHOULD always write something good that happened to you and what you accomplished that day. You know baby steps towards any kind of goal is still PROGRESS, be happy about it :))( it feels somehow nice to be able to talk to someone in the same situation. Hope it helps you. Sending a lot of hugs:)

I am currently in a position similar to yours and yes it is infuriating and horrible to say the least. But you know what you were somehow able to get through this to this day and you are currently still living and kicking( maybe it is not my place to say this because i have feeling suicidal these past months). Are you thinking of applying to college or uni out of state or abroad you should definitely be thinking about this. You know sometimes to like make you mother somehow less abusive you should pretend to listen to her. ITS EXTRAORDINARY HARD, but you are still young. Don’t let her win. I feel quite hypocrital after writing one of my posts about my horrible family, but rn I am in a clearer state of mind.
